$comment: Zero-count regions the browser coverage lane reports that ADR 0007 (adr/0007-scope-end-to-end-coverage-to-user-reachable-states.md) triages out of browser coverage. tests/tools/e2e-coverage-report.mjs counts each entry as neither covered nor uncovered and lists it in its own section; an entry whose span the run no longer reports, or now reports covered, is stale and fails the lane. Only the two ADR 0007 classes qualify: data-shape-guard for an arm selected solely by absent, null, empty or malformed build-time data, and span-drift for a zero that is a source-map artifact of a span another chunk or build records as executed. Spans are quoted from the report's Uncovered regions section.

entries.reason: `|| []` fallback taken only when data/case-studies.json has no caseStudies array.
`|| []` fallback taken only when a people section is missing from data/people.json.
`|| []` fallback taken only when the groups file has no groups array.
`|| []` fallback taken only when data/metrics.json lifecycle has no cards array.
`|| []` fallback taken only when data/metrics.json lifecycle has no omitted array.
`|| []` fallback taken only when data/radar-reports.json has no radarReports array.
`return null` when the mirror file carries no generatedAt.
`return null` when generatedAt is an unparseable date; the mapped span also covers the condition operand.
Inner `null` of the unparseable-date guard above, reported as its own region.
Bare `input` arm of the `searchChips ? ... : input` render; the member directory and case studies toolbars take it and the architecture catalog does not, in different chunks.
`return null` when an event's start or end is not a parseable date; scripts/lib/events-catalog.mjs rejects such a page at build time, so no published or fixture catalog carries one.
`wrapperClassName || styles.wrapper` spans both arms; MemberCard passes a class and ArchitectureCard does not, in different chunks, so the zero never meets a covered twin at the same key.
`lazy ? 'lazy' : undefined` spans both arms; MemberCard passes lazy and ArchitectureCard does not, in different chunks.
`maxWidth && {...}` spans both operands; MemberProfile sets maxWidth and the people dialog does not, in different chunks.
`maxHeight && {...}` spans both operands; MemberProfile sets maxHeight and the people dialog does not, in different chunks.
